description: This file defines an HTMLPurifier module called 'Edit' that handles editing-related HTML elements, such as <del> and <ins>, within the HTMLPurifier library. It sets up element configurations and child element definitions specific to editing semantics.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Edit
classes.description: A class extending HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule that configures editing-related HTML elements (<del> and <ins>) for the HTMLPurifier library, including setup and child element definition methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the module by adding 'del' and 'ins' elements with specific content models and attributes.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Determines the child element definition based on the content model, supporting chameleon content models that toggle between inline and block elements.
